Samir Rao: FYI CS flagged a high-severity customer report from FinFlow — repeated 502s + 5xx spikes for hosted inference in eu-west1 starting ~08:12 UTC. Customers seeing timeouts and auth retries. :rotating_light:
Maya Chen: putting on incident channel. what's the first repro? any request logs?
Samir Rao: customer provided curl: `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'` -> gets HTTP/2 502 and `upstream reset` in response body. Happens across multiple pods and AZs (eu-west1a/eu-west1b).
Kai Patel: looks like gateway returning 502 before our app logs it. Edge gateway logs show: `proxy: upstream error: stream reset (code:0x2)` and `502 gateway_response`.
Maya Chen: CS says token auth errors also intermittent (401 then immediate 502). Could be upstream resets dropping auth handshake mid-flight.
NetOps Bot: Alert: increased packet loss 0.8-2.5% on provider path between eu-west1a -> provider-AS12345 observed at 08:10-08:26 UTC. BGP updates: AS-path change at 08:09:57 UTC.
Kai Patel: can someone paste mtr/traceroute from an affected host?
Samir Rao: from hosted-edge-019 (eu-west1a):
```\nroot@hosted-edge-019:~# mtr -c 30 -r provider-router
Start: 2026-03-17 08:15:22
HOST: hosted-edge-019
1. 10.0.0.1     0.0%  0.6ms
2. 203.0.113.1 0.0%  1.2ms
3. 198.51.100.5 1.7%  5.9ms
4. 198.51.100.9 2.9%  12.4ms
5. 192.0.2.17   4.8%  24.1ms  <-- packet loss increases here
```\nSamir Rao: we see spikes at provider hop 5.
Maya Chen: matches NetOps Bot BGP path flips note. This smells like asymmetric or partial packet dupe/loss causing our gateway to fail streaming auth handshake and reset upstream.
CS Escalation: customer logs: repeated `context cancelled` and `rpc error: code = Internal desc = upstream closed connection` around same times. Their SLA requests a mitigation asap.
Kai Patel: immediate mitigations: 1) shift edge pool traffic for eu-west1 to eu-west3 and eu-central zones via routing policy to avoid affected provider, 2) enable emergency retry/backoff in gateway for auth token handshake, 3) increase edge idle timeout so transient dupes don't reset streams. I'll start (1) now.
Maya Chen: @L3 Oncall can you coordinate the routing change? we need to update smart-routing policy to prefer eu-west3 for new sessions, keep existing sticky sessions for 5m to reduce churn.
L3 Oncall: on it. Pushing router policy update to prefer eu-west3 (priority bump) and adding a fallback route via provider-AS67890. ETA 5m.
NetOps Bot: Route change applied from control-plane at 08:21:05 UTC (propagating). Provider AS12345 still reporting microbursts.
Samir Rao: after shifting ~30% of traffic we see 70% drop in 502s from customer metrics. Customer confirms partial improvement.
Kai Patel: can we also add a short-term rule at gateway to TTL-probe and avoid opening long-lived http2 upstreams to the flaky provider? i.e. prefer fresh connections for auth packets.
Maya Chen: agreed. Kai, can you post the config diff you'll apply?
Kai Patel: plan: at edge-nginx we will set `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection \"close\";` for auth endpoints and add `proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_504` to enable immediate failover. Applying as patch to canary group only first.
Samir Rao: rolling canary patch to 10% of gateways in eu-west1 now.
CS Escalation: customer acknowledged improvement, still seeing occasional 502s ~1/hr. They asked for RCA and timeline.
Maya Chen: next steps: NetOps to engage provider-AS12345 for packet-drop/BGP flap root cause. Kai to run postmortem on gateway resets and tune timeouts. CS to send interim report to FinFlow with mitigation steps and ETA for full fix.
L3 Oncall: provider ticket opened (P-7745) and I've attached mtr + timestamps. Engaging provider support.
NetOps Bot: Provider responded: investigating a misconfigured eBGP session causing transient drops; will patch within 3 hours.
Samir Rao: thanks. I'll keep channel updated. tagging @Maya Chen for final signoff on customer communication. :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: drafting interim message: \"We observed provider network instability causing transient packet loss and BGP path changes in eu-west1 which led to upstream connection resets and 502 responses. We routed traffic away from the affected path and applied gateway retries; you'll see reduced failures. We'll follow up with full RCA once provider patch completes.\" Posting in 10m unless objections.
CS Escalation: fine to send. Please include temporary mitigation and contact path.
Samir Rao: no objections. closing this thread when provider confirms patch and we validate 24h stable metrics.
